evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp to properly respect descriptor range_start.
rationale: Fixes a wallet correctness bug where keys below range_start are temporarily treated as IsMine during import rescan but drop out of the wallet balance after reload. It also eliminates pathological O(M) key derivation stalls when importing high range starts, reducing an author test from 19.5s to 0.09s.
